notes: §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR1 (amended): 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' SequentialIoBinder.BindWrite hands the FROM operand to MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase, which asks StatementValidation.CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf, RecordAreaRule.InForce: Year < 2023; COBOL6827) and screens the function category against FromPhraseRules.Write (COBOL1914). Function sentence holds at 85: LENGTH, ORD and NUMVAL refused; UPPER-CASE, CHAR, REVERSE, CURRENT-DATE run; NATIONAL-OF is COBOL1502, so the row's national widening is unreachable. Storage sentence holds for the record, another 01 of the FD, a whole-record subordinate (the witness OUT-FLD), a SAME RECORD AREA peer's record and an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record (all COBOL6827), but WRITE R1 FROM R1(1:10) and WRITE R1 FROM R1-E(1) (01 R1-T. 05 R1-E OCCURS 1 TIMES PIC X(10), the whole area) compile and run: IsRecordAreaOf answers false for any reference-modified or subscripted operand (docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b)), though each references the identical storage. A part of the record and another file's record are accepted, as the rule permits. Probe classes: a (ref-mod at 1:10, OCCURS DEPENDING ON record with RECORD VARYING), b (each storage shape and numeric functions), c (FROM literal COBOL0871, NATIONAL-OF COBOL1502), d (group, elementary, alphanumeric and numeric functions), e (sequential OUTPUT then INPUT read-back; SAME RECORD AREA and SAME AREA); f does not reach this syntax rule. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-02.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now. The function sentence's COBOL1914 message now cites the 1985 rule of the file's module (kb/Work PB5486: FromPhraseRules.FunctionRuleCite is an EditionCite).

next.reason: §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR1 as amended: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence; X3.23b-1993 restored the storage sentence to an unconditional one (the 1985 print: 'must not refer to the same storage area'). (a) Function: §2023:14.9.51.3 SR4 ('it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function') and §2023:14.9.51.3 SR11 ('identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function'): the words 'or national' and 'boolean' widen what is accepted. (b) Storage: 2023 has no syntax rule refusing the overlap. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 makes WRITE ... FROM a MOVE to the record followed by the WRITE, and its NOTE 1 applies 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with record-name-1 share any part of their storage areas', the WRITE being 'undefined if the result of execution of the implicit MOVE statement' is; §2023:14.6.10 GR1: 'the result of the statement is undefined' unless, §2023:14.6.10 GR2, the items share a data description entry ('the same as if the data items shared no part'); §2023:14.9.51.4 GR9 contemplates identifier-1 being 'one or part of one of the record descriptions'. A source 1985 refuses is accepted, with a defined or an undefined result and no exception condition.
